tagDefs.reason: Expects 1 + 24/25 days because 4 November 2018 lasts 25 hours in America/New_York; in other zones that day lasts 24 hours and the value matches Temporal.
Expects 2999 hours, which holds where one spring-forward hour falls in the span (America/New_York); in other zones the hour count matches Temporal.
Expects the America/New_York day, hour and offset (-300) of the parsed instant.
Expects the America/New_York day, hour, offset and zone name of the parsed instant.
Expects the host zone's names to be Eastern Daylight Time and EDT.
Expects the host zone to be America/New_York.
Expects the host zone name America/New_York.
The test instant 2011-07-31T14:48Z is already 1 August at offsets of +09:12 or more; the result matches Temporal for that local date.
The test's now, 2015-01-15T14:21Z, is already Friday 16 January at offsets of +09:39 or more, so the calendar labels name other days; each matches Temporal's day count.
The test starts from 2015-01-01T00:00Z, which is 31 December 2014 at negative offsets; the result matches Temporal for that local date.
The test formats the Unix epoch, 1970-01-01T00:00Z, which is still 1969 at negative offsets; the year printed matches Temporal.

causeDefs.cause: From V8 13.6 (Node 24), `Intl.Locale.prototype.getWeekInfo()` returns no `minimalDays`, so Luxon uses its fallback of 4 (src/impl/locale.js:80-84); the en-US test expects 1.
ICU 78.3 (CLDR 48) names the Ethiopic era `AM`; the test expects `ERA1`.
V8 14.6 (Node 26) formats with U+0020 before AM or PM where the test expects U+202F.
On Node 22 and 24 (V8 12.4, 13.6) the es-ES day period is `p.` U+202F `m.`; the parser matches U+0020 or U+00A0 between its parts (src/impl/tokenParser.js:15-16).
ICU 78.3 (CLDR 48) gives the Thai day period as `PM`; the test parses `หลังเที่ยง`, so `rawMatches` is null.
For the repeated wall time 2012-11-04 01:00 in America/New_York, Day.js gives offset -05:00 and the test expects moment-timezone 0.5.31's -04:00, in every host zone.

On Node 26 the function API uses the built-in Temporal (src/funcApi/plainDate.ts:316), whose `total()` is rounded once; the test compares it with the polyfill's class implementation, which rounds twice and differs in the last bit (25/7 weeks: 3.5714285714285716 against 3.571428571428571; 424/365 years: 1.1616438356164382 against 1.1616438356164385).
The test expects the last Africa/Casablanca transition before 2100-07-01 at 2087-05-11T02:00Z; with tzdata 2026e the last one is 2026-09-20T01:00Z.
